hook.text_top: This samurai cat beat an entire ninja clan.
hook.voice: This samurai cat beat an entire ninja clan.

intro_voice: Here's the original, made with Seedance 2.5.

shots.excerpt: Medium close-up, three-quarter side view: orange tabby in a woven straw kasa hat, katana slung across its back, reed stalk in its mouth; very slow push-in.
shots.voice: Shot 1. A slow push-in on our ronin. The hat, the katana and the reed stalk sell the character instantly.

shots.excerpt: Wide, ground-level low angle: the cat leaps off the mossy boulder and sprints at the camera; the camera tracks backward with heavy motion blur.
shots.voice: Shot 2. The camera sits at cat height and runs backward, so every ninja towers over it.

shots.excerpt: Ground-level side close-up, slow motion: the cat slides on its belly as a katana blade sweeps just above the brim of its hat.
highlight: just above the brim of its hat
shots.voice: Shot 3. Slow motion and a blade just above the hat. That near miss is pure tension.

shots.excerpt: The cat rides a bundle of reeds as they bend low, springs off and somersaults upside down mid-air in slow motion, the hat spinning.
shots.voice: Shot 6. The reeds bend like a spring and launch it into a slow-motion flip.

shots.excerpt: Low locked-off camera at deck level. The cat spins like a whirlwind mid-air, ninjas blasted into the water, then walks calmly to the lens.
highlight: Low locked-off camera at deck level
shots.voice: Shot 10. A locked-off camera on the boat deck. The cat spins, the ninjas fly, and it strolls up to the lens.

outro_voice: The full prompt is in the caption. Follow Mira AI for a new one every day.
